Customs Act 1969: The government exercises authority granted under section 19(1) of the Customs Act 1969 to amend existing notification schedules regarding customs duties.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: The government exercises regulatory authority granted under section 14(1) of this Act to implement amendments related to tax-exempt or regulated imports.
National Board of Revenue: The government is required to consult with the National Board of Revenue before issuing or amending notifications related to customs and taxation.
S.R.O. 128-AIN/2017/14/Customs: This notification is being officially amended to update the classification of goods under specific headings.
H.S. Code: The existing H.S. Code entries associated with Heading 85.01 in the table of the specified notification are replaced with a revised set of codes, excluding certain specified items from the coverage.
TABLE: The table within the specified notification is updated to replace the previous H.S. Codes under Heading 85.01 with a new list of codes for regulatory clarity.
